text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will not meet Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Saturday, an Arafat aide said.
"There is no meeting planned for tonight," Arafat adviser Nabil Abu Rdainah told Reuters.

The United States has been working frantically behind the scenes to arrange a meeting between Netanyahu and Arafat to end an explosion of violence that has claimed almost 70 lives and shaken Washington's Middle East peacemaking efforts.
Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak has offered to host the meeting in Cairo.

"There are American efforts to hold a three-way meeting in Cairo as soon as possible. The Palestinian Authority welcomes such a meeting but the Israelis have not responded to Mubarak's invitation yet," Abu Rdainah said.
He said there are preparations under way for a four-way meeting including the United States.
